ritual.ironrituals.sun.hint: "Let gold call the dawn and the flower follow its face."
ritual.ironrituals.night.hint: "When blood begs for rest, the sun has no voice."
ritual.ironrituals.deluge.hint: "Five seas, ten leaves and the tear of a floating being."
ritual.ironrituals.dome.hint: "A wall no one sees and everyone respects."
ritual.ironrituals.prison.hint: "What goes in does not always come out."
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_suppression.hi: "When the book falls silent, even the ember forgets its name."
ritual.ironrituals.sanctuary.hint: "Where light guards its own, shadow finds no cradle."
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_spring.hint: "The spring never runs dry if it is named rightly."
ritual.ironrituals.sentinel.hint: "An eye that never sleeps counts the steps of strangers."
ritual.ironrituals.sepulchral_silence.hi: "Where the echo dies, not even the beast of the deep hears its prey's heartbeat."
ritual.ironrituals.inverted_gravity.hint: "When stone forgets its weight, even iron learns to fall towards the clouds."
ritual.ironrituals.time_distortion.hint: "The grain falls slower towards the heart of the hourglass; only the one who turns it does not drown in the sand."
ritual.ironrituals.mirror.hint: "A strange place, desolate and dead, where no one sees or touches you."
ritual.ironrituals.phoenix.hint: "Who dies in flames is born in flames."
ritual.ironrituals.metamorphosis.hint: "That which is made of you walks beside you."
ritual.ironrituals.shrinking.hint: "Small is the one who watches the world from the mushroom."
ritual.ironrituals.scapegoat.hint: "Two hearts beat as one, yet only one feels the blade and the poison."
ritual.ironrituals.temporal_paradox.hint: "The hourglass does not fall; it waits for the thread to snap to return the grain to the top."
ritual.ironrituals.soul_anchor.hint: "What you bind to the soul, death does not unbind."
ritual.ironrituals.silent_echo.hint: "A pulseless form that mimics what once was."
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_bond.hint: "What swore loyalty is never wholly lost."
ritual.ironrituals.planar_nexus.hint: "Grass, burning rock and stone of the end: three worlds through one door."
ritual.ironrituals.intrusion.hint: "A door that is not yours opens when you speak its name."
ritual.ironrituals.astral_projection.hin: "Leave your flesh beside the candles and let your gaze pass through stone like mist."
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_forge.hint: "What fire forges, time does not wear."
ritual.ironrituals.terraforming.hint: "The memory of the earth is malleable when offered the seed of another world."
ritual.ironrituals.custody.hint: "A lock that knows only its master."
ritual.ironrituals.sun.lore: The priests of dawn kept gold in their tombs so the sun would find them upon waking.
ritual.ironrituals.night.lore: A vial of blood on an empty bed: so the ancients begged the day to fall silent.
ritual.ironrituals.deluge.lore: The swamp witches did not pray for rain: they summoned it with what water leaves behind.
ritual.ironrituals.dome.lore: The strongest walls are not of stone, but of glass hardened by faith.
ritual.ironrituals.prison.lore: The jailers of the End built no cells: they folded space until no exit remained.
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_suppression.lo: There was an order that feared magic more than death. This was their legacy.
ritual.ironrituals.sanctuary.lore: Where a saint once slept, the earth remembers their peace for generations.
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_spring.lore: Beneath the wizards' towers there was always a spring no one was seen drinking from.
ritual.ironrituals.sentinel.lore: The Ender eye never blinks; it only learns whom it must watch.
ritual.ironrituals.sepulchral_silence.lo: In the ancient cities, those who survived learned to make no sound at all.
ritual.ironrituals.inverted_gravity.lore: Shulkers float because they remember a world where the ground was above.
ritual.ironrituals.time_distortion.lore: A broken clock at the heart of a circle makes the whole world hesitate.
ritual.ironrituals.mirror.lore: Beyond the glass lies a grey world where the living are only shadows.
ritual.ironrituals.phoenix.lore: No phoenix dies twice; the first one who tried is still burning.
ritual.ironrituals.metamorphosis.lore: Blood mages learned that a borrowed soul can wear your shape.
ritual.ironrituals.shrinking.lore: The druids of the dark forest made themselves small to listen to the roots.
ritual.ironrituals.scapegoat.lore: All pain seeks a body. This ritual only teaches it which one.
ritual.ironrituals.temporal_paradox.lore: Whoever keeps a moment in sand may return to it, but only once.
ritual.ironrituals.soul_anchor.lore: A diamond does not rot. Bound to the soul, neither does what you carry.
ritual.ironrituals.silent_echo.lore: The echo of a creature can linger even when the creature is gone.
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_bond.lore: The keepers of beasts never buried their companions: they waited.
ritual.ironrituals.guardian.lore: The evokers did not forge soldiers; they called them from sleeping iron.
ritual.ironrituals.planar_nexus.lore: Three stones from three worlds, and distance ceases to have meaning.
ritual.ironrituals.intrusion.lore: Every soul leaves a door ajar. One only needs to know its name.
ritual.ironrituals.astral_projection.lor: The seers left their bodies beside the candles and returned with secrets.
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_forge.lore: The first arcane smith tempered his hammer in a flame that has yet to go out.
ritual.ironrituals.terraforming.lore: The earth does not forget; it only waits for someone to remind it of another landscape.
ritual.ironrituals.harvest.lore: The valley alchemists had three harvests a year and no seasons.
ritual.ironrituals.custody.lore: An arcane seal does not prevent opening: it prevents wanting to.
ritual.ironrituals.sun.catalyst.freeze_c: If the clock listens to the amethyst, the sun forgets to move.
ritual.ironrituals.night.catalyst.freeze: If the clock listens to the amethyst, the moon does not leave.
ritual.ironrituals.deluge.catalyst.storm: The sky, too, can be bottled.
ritual.ironrituals.dome.catalyst.blaze: Nether dust teaches the wall to bite.
ritual.ironrituals.dome.catalyst.ender_s: A watchful eye closes the shortcuts.
ritual.ironrituals.prison.catalyst.one_w: The skin of those who fly by night only lets in.
ritual.ironrituals.prison.catalyst.contr: The soul of that which swells makes the cage shrink.
ritual.ironrituals.arcane_suppression.ca: What is snuffed out can be kept in a lantern or a breath.
ritual.ironrituals.inverted_gravity.cata: Heavy iron reminds the world of its weight.
ritual.ironrituals.time_distortion.catal: Who drinks haste does not feel the sand.
ritual.ironrituals.mirror.catalyst.revea: One more eye sees through stone.
ritual.ironrituals.phoenix.catalyst.fire: A charge and a rod: rebirth can burn.
ritual.ironrituals.shrinking.catalyst.cl: The lucky foot fears no wall.
ritual.ironrituals.scapegoat.catalyst.pl: A soul with a name can bear your pain from afar.
A rope teaches the echo to follow you.
ritual.ironrituals.eternal_forge.catalys: Obsidian that weeps shields against fire.
ritual.ironrituals.terraforming.catalyst: Black stone and fungus: the earth darkens.
Ice and frozen bone: the earth freezes.
Bone, water and seed: the earth blooms.
